escena: SCENE (Efeonce office, Santiago, high floor, late morning): a corner of the Efeonce open-plan office next to the team desks, seen from the chair of someone sitting there on a video call — camera at SEATED EYE LEVEL (about 1.15 m), 28 mm lens at f/5.6, like a good webcam view, looking straight at a wall 3 m away whose RIGHT part is smooth warm-white matte plaster and whose LEFT part is vertical light-oak acoustic slats; horizon level, verticals straight. RIGHT THIRD: Image 2 is the final artwork of the lettering on the plaster — «Crecimiento orgánico» with its azure sphere as the period — reproduce it exactly as cut matte navy vinyl letters, mounted high; below it, on the microcement floor, one sculptural rubber plant in a large matte white cylindrical planter, its top leaves just under the lettering. LEFT THIRD: a slim black steel shelf across the oak slats at head height holding a small brushed-steel trophy cup with no engraving and the official Efeonce logo from Image 1 as a small solid DEEP NAVY (#023C70, dark ink blue, never royal blue) desk object about 24 cm wide and 6 cm tall, standing upright on the shelf beside the trophy, turned towards the camera: product placement, reproduced exactly (every letter of «efeonce», the ship emblem with its orbit ring, its cuts and its three small windows), satin finish, crisp bevel. At the left edge, a team desk with a current-generation borderless monitor whose screen shows Image 3 (a dashboard with the Efeonce AEO logo in its header), and on the desk a navy felt desk mat with a thin printed orbit at its right end — a fine ring, a short arc and a small azure sphere — under a wireless mouse. LIGHT: hard low sun from the LEFT through floor-to-ceiling glazing crosses the space as crisp shafts and throws a sharp, graphic shadow of the plant's leaves across the plaster beside the lettering; the centre of the wall stays calm and evenly lit. TRACES OF WORK: a graphite mesh chair pushed back at an angle at the bottom left, a notebook left open on the desk. MODERN FLOOR (2026, premium technology company): floor-to-ceiling glazing with slim black frames; smooth exposed concrete ceiling with recessed black linear LED profiles switched off; seamless pale microcement floor; furniture with clean lines — pale solid-surface or light-oak tables on slim black steel legs, graphite ergonomic mesh chairs, handle-less storage; current-generation technology only. At most ONE sculptural plant in the whole frame. Nothing vintage or rustic: no reclaimed wood, no brass, no Edison bulbs, no wooden brackets, no clutter. Nothing else on the walls: no posters, no clocks, no extra signage and no extra text anywhere. TEXT EXCEPTION: the logo from Image 1 and the artworks from Image 2 and Image 3 are the ONLY readable marks in the picture; they stay crisp and legible, every letter and word exactly as in the references, never blurred, altered or translated; every other screen, paper or label stays illegible by physical means.
